documents.text: Big Fun (Shalamar album) Big Fun is the third album by American R&B group Shalamar, released in 1979 on the SOLAR label. "Big Fun" was produced by Leon Sylvers III and is the first album to feature what is considered the 'classic' Shalamar line-up (Jeffrey Daniel, Howard Hewett and Jody Watley), with Hewett having replaced Gerald Brown. The album features the group's biggest hit single, "The Second Time Around". "Big Fun" has been certified Gold in the United States for sales of over 500,000.
